name: FLUX.2 [max]
description: BFL's highest-fidelity FLUX.2, multi-reference editing. Also on WaveSpeedAI. Also on Comfy Cloud. Also on OpenRouter. Also on Comfy Router. Adapter written from the provider's docs, not run against the live API yet.

bfl.note: Instruction edit of the crop plus the reference layers, no mask input: the stitch keeps the selection. For area-directed edits set Fill to green and Original on, and say "fill the green area".

fal.note: Instruction edit of the crop plus the reference layers, no mask input: the stitch keeps the selection. For area-directed edits set Fill to green and Original on, and say "fill the green area".

replicate.note: Instruction edit of the crop plus the reference layers, no mask input: the stitch keeps the selection. For area-directed edits set Fill to green and Original on, and say "fill the green area".

wavespeed.note: Instruction edit of the crop plus the reference layers, no mask input: the stitch keeps the selection. For area-directed edits set Fill to green and Original on, and say "fill the green area".

comfycloud.note: Runs the Partner Node on Comfy Cloud (paid plan, credits). Size fitted to the crop (256 to 2048 px, multiples of 32). Instruction edit of the crop plus the reference layers, no mask input: the stitch keeps the selection. For area-directed edits set Fill to green and Original on, and say "fill the green area".

openrouter.note: Runs on OpenRouter (one key for many models); the adapter has run against the live API with GPT Image 2.5, this model not yet. The pictures go inline in the request to OpenRouter, which passes them to Black Forest Labs. Instruction edit of the crop plus the reference layers, no mask input: the stitch keeps the selection. For area-directed edits set Fill to green and Original on, and say "fill the green area". An edit sends no aspect, so the host keeps the crop's shape as its own edit endpoint does (not verified); an answer of another shape is centre-cropped. There is no size parameter: the host picks the output size. At most eight pictures go in (the crop, Original and the reference layers).

comfyrouter.note: Runs on Comfy Router (api.comfy.org) with the Comfy Cloud key, billed in Comfy credits, no paid plan needed; not run against the live API yet. The pictures go inline in the request to Comfy, which passes them to Black Forest Labs; the answer comes back through Comfy's storage. Instruction edit of the crop plus the reference layers, no mask input: the stitch keeps the selection. For area-directed edits set Fill to green and Original on, and say "fill the green area". The crop goes at its own size (256 to 2048 px a side, 16 px steps). At most nine pictures go in (the crop, Original and the reference layers). Prompt upsampling is off unless switched on (the Router's own default is on).

magnificsub.note: Runs on your Magnific plan (Premium, Premium+ or Pro) through Magnific's MCP server (mcp.magnific.com), after signing in under Settings › API providers; each run spends the plan's credits, the same balance as Magnific's web app, and the status line says how many. The pictures are uploaded to Magnific (Freepik Company S.L., Málaga, Spain) as hidden uploads; the results are Magnific creations and show in your Magnific library. Not run against the live service with this model yet. Magnific's Flux.2 Max (images_generate). Generate on a selection: the crop goes as the picture to edit, followed by the Original and the reference layers (at most 12 pictures together), with the prompt as an instruction; no mask goes along, the stitch keeps the selection. The crop's context is widened to the model's aspect ratio closest to it, and the answer comes back at the model's own size. Generate new: the prompt and the shown reference layers (at most 12, named in the prompt as image 1, image 2, ...); the aspect ratio is the model's closest to the asked size. Resolution is the model's size tier, for an edit and a new image alike (Default: the model's own).
